courses.name: Java Programming
courses.description: Advanced Java programming covering OOP concepts, collections, multithreading, I/O systems, and modern Java features including streams and lambdas.

units.title: Java Fundamentals & OOP
units.description: Core Java syntax, classes, inheritance, interfaces, and polymorphism

lessons.title: Java Platform & JVM Architecture
lessons.content: Understanding JVM, bytecode, class loading mechanism, and memory management in Java.

lessons.title: Classes, Objects & Encapsulation
lessons.content: Creating classes, constructors, access modifiers, getters/setters, and the 'this' keyword.

lessons.title: Inheritance & Polymorphism
lessons.content: extends keyword, method overriding, super keyword, abstract classes, and dynamic method dispatch.

lessons.title: Interfaces & Abstract Classes
lessons.content: Defining interfaces, default methods, functional interfaces, and when to use abstract vs interface.

lessons.title: Packages & Access Control
lessons.content: Package declaration, import statements, classpath, and access modifiers in depth.

units.title: Collections Framework & Generics
units.description: Java Collections Framework, generic types, and type safety

lessons.title: Generics & Type Parameters
lessons.content: Generic classes, methods, bounded type parameters, and type erasure.

lessons.title: List, Set & Queue Interfaces
lessons.content: ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, TreeSet, PriorityQueue and their use cases.

lessons.title: Map Interfaces & Implementations
lessons.content: HashMap, TreeMap, LinkedHashMap, ConcurrentHashMap and hash table concepts.

lessons.title: Comparable & Comparator
lessons.content: Natural ordering with Comparable, custom sorting with Comparator, and lambda-based sorting.

lessons.title: Stream API & Lambda Expressions
lessons.content: Functional programming in Java: streams, map/filter/reduce, method references, and Optional.

units.title: Multithreading & Concurrency
units.description: Thread management, synchronization, and concurrent utilities

lessons.title: Thread Creation & Lifecycle
lessons.content: Extending Thread class, implementing Runnable, thread states, and daemon threads.

lessons.title: Synchronization & Locks
lessons.content: Synchronized blocks/methods, intrinsic locks, reentrant locks, and deadlock prevention.

lessons.title: Inter-Thread Communication
lessons.content: wait(), notify(), notifyAll() methods, producer-consumer pattern, and condition variables.

lessons.title: Executor Framework
lessons.content: Thread pools, ExecutorService, Callable/Future, and ScheduledExecutorService.

lessons.title: Concurrent Collections & Utilities
lessons.content: ConcurrentHashMap, CopyOnWriteArrayList, CountDownLatch, CyclicBarrier, and atomic variables.

units.title: Java I/O & Networking
units.description: File handling, serialization, and network programming

lessons.title: Byte Streams & Character Streams
lessons.content: InputStream/OutputStream, Reader/Writer hierarchies, buffering, and data streams.

lessons.title: File I/O & NIO
lessons.content: File class, RandomAccessFile, NIO channels, buffers, and Files utility class.

lessons.title: Object Serialization
lessons.content: Serializable interface, transient keyword, serialVersionUID, and custom serialization.

lessons.title: Socket Programming
lessons.content: TCP sockets, ServerSocket, UDP datagrams, and building a simple client-server application.

lessons.title: Java NIO & Asynchronous I/O
lessons.content: Non-blocking I/O, selectors, channels, and AsynchronousSocketChannel.

units.title: Advanced Java Features
units.description: Modules, records, patterns, and modern Java idioms

lessons.title: Java Module System (JPMS)
lessons.content: module-info.java, module descriptors, requires/exports directives, and service loading.

lessons.title: Records, Sealed Classes & Pattern Matching
lessons.content: Record classes, sealed hierarchies, pattern matching for instanceof and switch.

lessons.title: Date & Time API
lessons.content: java.time package: LocalDate, LocalTime, Duration, Period, and timezone handling.

lessons.title: JDBC & Database Connectivity
lessons.content: Connection, Statement, PreparedStatement, ResultSet, and transaction management.

lessons.title: Reflection & Annotations
lessons.content: Class loading, reflective access, built-in annotations, creating custom annotations, and annotation processing.

courses.name: Data Warehouse & Data Pipeline
courses.description: Concepts and technologies for data warehousing, ETL processes, dimensional modeling, and modern data pipeline architectures.

units.title: Data Warehouse Concepts & Architecture
units.description: Fundamental concepts of data warehousing and system architecture

lessons.title: Introduction to Data Warehousing
lessons.content: Definition, characteristics, and need for data warehouses. OLTP vs OLAP systems.

lessons.title: Data Warehouse Architecture
lessons.content: Three-tier architecture: bottom tier (DB), middle tier (OLAP), top tier (reporting). Data marts and ODS.

lessons.title: ETL vs ELT Approaches
lessons.content: Extract, Transform, Load processes. When to use ETL vs ELT. Modern data integration patterns.

lessons.title: Data Warehouse Lifecycle
lessons.content: Kimball lifecycle methodology: project planning, requirements gathering, dimensional modeling, implementation.

lessons.title: Data Quality & Governance
lessons.content: Data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, data lineage, and metadata management.

units.title: Dimensional Modeling
units.description: Star schema, snowflake schema, fact and dimension table design

lessons.title: Fact Tables
lessons.content: Transactional, periodic snapshot, and accumulating snapshot fact tables. Grain declaration.

lessons.title: Dimension Tables
lessons.content: Conformed, degenerate, junk, and role-playing dimensions. SCD types (Type 0, 1, 2, 3).

lessons.title: Star Schema Design
lessons.content: Fact table in center surrounded by dimension tables. Benefits and trade-offs of star schema.

lessons.title: Snowflake Schema Design
lessons.content: Normalized dimensions, hierarchy representation, and when to use snowflake over star.

lessons.title: Slowly Changing Dimensions
lessons.content: Implementing Type 0 through Type 6 SCDs. Handling history and current values.

units.title: ETL Processes & Tools
units.description: Building robust ETL pipelines with industry tools

lessons.title: Data Extraction Strategies
lessons.content: Full vs incremental extraction, CDC (Change Data Capture), and API-based extraction.

lessons.title: Data Transformation Techniques
lessons.content: Cleaning, mapping, aggregation, enrichment, and data type conversions.

lessons.title: Data Loading Methods
lessons.content: Initial load, incremental load, upsert/merge strategies, and batch vs streaming loads.

lessons.title: Apache NiFi & Airflow
lessons.content: Building data pipelines with Apache NiFi and orchestrating with Apache Airflow DAGs.

lessons.title: dbt for Data Transformation
lessons.content: Data build tool: models, tests, documentation, and incremental models in modern ELT.

units.title: Data Pipeline Architecture
units.description: Designing scalable and reliable data pipelines

lessons.title: Batch Processing Architecture
lessons.content: Batch pipeline design patterns, scheduling, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.

lessons.title: Streaming Data Pipelines
lessons.content: Kafka topics, producers/consumers, stream processing with Kafka Streams and Flink.

lessons.title: Lambda & Kappa Architectures
lessons.content: Batch + streaming (Lambda) vs pure streaming (Kappa) architecture trade-offs.

lessons.title: Data Lakehouse Architecture
lessons.content: Lakehouse paradigm: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and combining data lakes with warehouse capabilities.

lessons.title: Pipeline Monitoring & Observability
lessons.content: Data quality checks, lineage tracking, alerting, SLA monitoring, and pipeline debugging.

units.title: Modern Data Platforms
units.description: Cloud data warehouses and big data technologies

lessons.title: Cloud Data Warehouses
lessons.content: Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery architecture, pricing, and use cases.

lessons.title: Apache Spark for Data Processing
lessons.content: Spark RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, and optimizing Spark jobs for ETL.

lessons.title: Data Catalog & Discovery
lessons.content: Data catalog tools, schema registry, data discovery, and business glossary management.

lessons.title: OLAP Cubes & MDX
lessons.content: Multidimensional OLAP, cube operations (drill-down, roll-up, slice, dice), and MDX queries.

lessons.title: Data Warehouse Performance Tuning
lessons.content: Indexing strategies, partitioning, clustering, materialized views, and query optimization.

courses.name: Data Structures
courses.description: Comprehensive study of data structures including arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hash tables, and algorithm analysis.

units.title: Linear Data Structures
units.description: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues with their applications

lessons.title: Arrays & Dynamic Arrays
lessons.content: Array operations, time complexity, dynamic resizing, and multi-dimensional arrays.

lessons.title: Singly & Doubly Linked Lists
lessons.content: Node structure, insertion, deletion, traversal, reversal, and circular linked lists.

lessons.title: Stacks & Applications
lessons.content: Stack operations, array vs linked list implementation, expression evaluation, and undo functionality.

lessons.title: Queues & Deques
lessons.content: Queue, circular queue, priority queue, deque operations, and scheduling applications.

lessons.title: Skip Lists
lessons.content: Probabilistic data structure, levels, search/insert/delete operations, and performance analysis.

units.title: Trees & Tree Algorithms
units.description: Binary trees, BSTs, AVL trees, B-trees, and tree traversals

lessons.title: Binary Trees & Traversals
lessons.content: Tree terminology, inorder/preorder/postorder/level-order traversals, and recursive implementations.

lessons.title: Binary Search Trees
lessons.content: BST property, search, insert, delete operations, and analysis of balanced vs skewed trees.

lessons.title: AVL Trees & Rotations
lessons.content: Balance factor, LL/RR/LR/RL rotations, insertion and deletion in AVL trees.

lessons.title: B-Trees & B+ Trees
lessons.content: Multi-way search trees, B-tree properties, insertion/deletion algorithms, and database indexing.

lessons.title: Heaps & Heap Sort
lessons.content: Min-heap, max-heap, heapify, heap sort algorithm, and priority queue implementation.

units.title: Graphs & Graph Algorithms
units.description: Graph representations, traversals, shortest paths, and spanning trees

lessons.title: Graph Representations
lessons.content: Adjacency matrix, adjacency list, edge list, and space-time trade-offs.

lessons.title: BFS & DFS Traversals
lessons.content: Breadth-first search, depth-first search, connected components, and topological sort.

lessons.title: Shortest Path Algorithms
lessons.content: Dijkstra's algorithm, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, and A* search.

lessons.title: Minimum Spanning Trees
lessons.content: Prim's algorithm, Kruskal's algorithm, union-find data structure, and applications.

lessons.title: Network Flow & Matching
lessons.content: Ford-Fulkerson method, Edmonds-Karp algorithm, max-flow min-cut theorem, and bipartite matching.

units.title: Hash Tables & Dictionaries
units.description: Hash functions, collision resolution, and hash-based data structures

lessons.title: Hash Functions & Design
lessons.content: Properties of good hash functions, universal hashing, cryptographic vs non-cryptographic hashes.

lessons.title: Collision Resolution Strategies
lessons.content: Chaining, open addressing (linear/quadratic probing), double hashing, and performance analysis.

lessons.title: Bloom Filters
lessons.content: Probabilistic membership testing, false positive rate, bit array operations, and applications.

lessons.title: Cuckoo Hashing & Hopscotch Hashing
lessons.content: Cuckoo hashing with multiple tables, hopscotch hashing with neighborhood concept.

lessons.title: Consistent Hashing
lessons.content: Distributed hash tables, consistent hashing for load balancing, and Dynamo-style databases.

units.title: Advanced Data Structures
units.description: Trie, segment tree, Fenwick tree, and union-find

lessons.title: Tries & Prefix Trees
lessons.content: Trie structure, insertion, search, prefix matching, autocomplete systems, and space optimization (radix tree).

lessons.title: Segment Trees
lessons.content: Range query and point update, building segment trees, lazy propagation, and 2D segment trees.

lessons.title: Fenwick Tree (BIT)
lessons.content: Binary indexed tree, prefix sum queries, point updates, and range updates.

lessons.title: Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find)
lessons.content: Union by rank, path compression, cycle detection in graphs, and Kruskal's algorithm integration.

lessons.title: Suffix Arrays & LCP
lessons.content: Suffix array construction, longest common prefix array, and applications in pattern matching.
